title: prepush.py runs check_manager_scope.py, which exits 2 identity_unresolved on every lane branch (subject files MANAGER-LEASE.json/SESSIONS.json retired 2026-09-21): retire the guard from prepush or re-point it
note: Found 2026-11-12 by FUT-INTRADAY-DUKA-LANE. Repro: on any branch with commits ahead of origin/main, python3 scripts/ci/check_manager_scope.py --base origin/main -> exit 2, 'IDENTITY: lease retired, dispatch live, union roster EMPTY'. On origin/main itself it exits 0 (empty diff). Not referenced in .github/workflows, so CI is unaffected; prepush.py reports FAIL, which teaches lanes to ignore prepush. Done when prepush.py on a lane branch no longer lists manager-scope-guard as failing.
